source_text.body:
Generate ad reports and recommendations from ads data
A commenter connects Claude through an MCP connector to Meta, Google and TikTok ads so it produces reports and recommendations for performance marketing.
·
Oct 30, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
In the comments, one person says they use Meta’s official ads MCP and Google’s read-only server so Claude can access ad reporting data, while posting is handled separately through the paid scheduler Postiz. They organize work with a group per client in Postiz and a spreadsheet per client that Claude reads as the content calendar; the comment does not describe TikTok, automated recommendation steps, or any human review process.
How it went
The source only confirms that this setup covers reporting and posting for multiple clients. It gives no metrics, no time saved, and no stated performance results.
Worth knowing
The clearest implementation detail is the stack: Meta ads MCP, Google’s read-only server, Postiz for scheduling, and one sheet per client for Claude to read.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using my connected ad accounts on [Meta, Google, TikTok] for [date range], create a performance report covering spend, results, cost per result and the top and bottom campaigns for [goal, e.g. leads or sales]. Then give me [number] specific recommendations on what to change, with the data behind each. Stop once the report and recommendations are written, and do not change any budgets, ads or settings in the accounts.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xhsid4/performance_marketers_and_social_media_managers
